synopsis: The new provider has two localized type-contract gaps. Runtime success is not yet established.

failures.diagnosis: A value permitted to be undefined reaches fields/calls requiring a definite string.
failures.fix: Narrow or validate the optional string before constructing the required request fields. Avoid a non-null assertion unless the preceding guard guarantees presence.

failures.diagnosis: Function-call arguments are typed as arbitrary JSON, but the existing Step contract requires an object map; null and scalar JSON violate that contract.
failures.fix: Validate the runtime tool arguments as a non-null object and construct the existing FunctionCallStep using that narrowed object. Reject malformed arguments through the normal typed failure path rather than casting away the mismatch.

recommendations: Retest TypeScript compiler after both fixes; then exercise malformed tool arguments as an actual boundary test.
limitations: Only captured compiler diagnostics reviewed. No provider output, live endpoint or native behavior was inspected.
